risks.note: Management states that with the imposition of US tariffs 'your product Gelatin became uncompetitive in the US market for a substantial period of time', forcing a deliberate reduction of US exposure and redirection of volumes; gelatin exports fell year on year as customers became 'wary about the risk of non-supply, if contracted'. The Chairman's message warns that the potential continuation or expansion of tariff measures by major economies, including the United States, warrants continued caution, and the cautionary statement lists tariffs imposed by the US administration as a factor that may affect operations.
risks.risk: US tariff exposure and trade-policy volatility

risks.note: Listed by management as 'Supply Chain Volatility: Fluctuating raw material costs, particularly in the bovine sector, can cause margin pressure.' Crushed bone is described as 'the major raw material of the Company'; FY26 benefited from softened international crushed bone prices and cheaper hydrochloric acid and lime, but the report also notes that 'certain factors have exerted significant pressure on bone gelatin costs'. Mitigation cited is investment in sustainable and traceable sourcing, long-term contracts and development of new cost-effective vendors.
risks.risk: Raw material cost and supply volatility, concentrated on a single input (crushed bone)

risks.note: 'Pressure from substitutes: The growth of plant-based and synthetic (HPMC, Starch) capsules is challenging gelatin in specific, mostly premium or niche markets.' Demand for non-animal-based capsules such as HPMC and Pullulan is said to be increasing rapidly on dietary preferences. Management argues the shift is currently slowed by pharma-grade HPMC's high cost and 16-20-week lead times, and that gelatin remains dominant in the mainstream high-volume pharmaceutical segment - so the risk is structural but paced.

Surplus Chinese capacity and increased production of bovine hide gelatin and collagen peptides - driven by a weakening leather industry pushing hide suppliers into these outlets, and by closures of bone gelatin plants in the UK and US releasing additional bone - have created surplus supply and weakened bone gelatin demand among low-quality-conscious customers. Capsule makers are increasingly blending hide gelatin with bone gelatin to manage cost.
risks.risk: Competitive displacement by surplus hide-based gelatin and Chinese supply

risks.note: 'The Company has taken a conscious call not to service Chinese Gelatin customers due to gap in quality expectation and pricing pressure, which has resulted in a decline in market share in this specific segment.' The strategy concentrates the business in brand-conscious and regulated segments, which held up in FY26 but narrows the addressable base if quality premiums compress.
risks.risk: Deliberate market-share loss in the price-led segment

risks.note: Structural concentration disclosed in the Directors' Report: 'The entire sale of Ossein/Limed Ossein, 33% of the total sale of Gelatin and 69% of Collagen Peptide was through exports.' Ossein/limed ossein is entirely export-dependent and collagen peptide growth in FY26 leaned on a significant increase in North American demand - the same geography exposed to tariff action.

Prices of Limed Ossein, Gelatin and Bovine Peptide dropped by 9%, 3% and 9% respectively during 2025-26, and while collagen peptide volumes rose 57% the average realisation per unit declined 14.5% because of change in mix - volume growth is not translating one-for-one into value. Management notes price negotiations with both suppliers and customers are carried out on a regular basis to protect margins.

The cautionary statement enumerates that operations may be affected by the supply and demand situation, tariffs imposed by the US administration, input price and availability, changes in Government Regulations, Tax Laws and foreign exchange rate fluctuations. The report also shows regulation moving both ways for the Company - a new acid regulation made domestic Rock DCP production unviable, which lifted the Company's DCP realisation.
